Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

MessageState.description: Where a sent message stands. `queued`: held for the recipient and not yet handed over. `delivered`: handed to the recipient (pickup or live stream) and not yet removed by it. `collected`: removed by the recipient — acknowledged after pickup, fetched with delete, or deleted or purged by it. `withdrawn`: removed by the sender. `discarded`: removed by the mediator before the recipient took it — expired, or its account was removed. `unknown`: the mediator holds neither the message nor a receipt for it under the requester.
MessageState.title: MessageState

Response.description: The success response to a messaging/message/status request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/message/status/0.2#response.

statuses.description: One entry per requested msgId, in request order.

reachedAt.description: When the message reached this state: first handed over for `delivered`, removed for `collected`, `withdrawn` and `discarded`. Absent for `queued` and `unknown`, and wherever the mediator does not disclose it.

Response.title: Messaging — Message Status — response payload
